hypothesis: At a strong fresh intraday OB aligned with causal hourly support/resistance, a completed 5m close that reclaims the entire zone on the first contact is sufficient evidence of defense; a distal liquidity sweep is helpful but not mandatory. Direction must agree with the last completed BTC D1 close versus SMA200.

data.source: Binance public USD-M checksumed 1m kline and funding archives
data.true_oos: First UTC midnight after protocol/code freeze; minimum 180 days, 50 fills and 30 independent 4h event clusters

level.order_block: exactly the last opposing candle among the prior 3 bars

regime.indicator: last completed BTC D1 close versus SMA200

freshness_and_trigger.trigger: completed 5m close beyond proximal edge on the first contact episode
freshness_and_trigger.entry: market/taker at the next actual 1m open

risk.target: exactly 2.0 net-R under stress costs and before nearest causal opposing level

heldout_gates_and_portfolio_comparison: Identical to S90 protocol: validation/evaluation minimum 50 fills and 25 clusters each, PF >= 1.15, mean R >= 0.08, then fixed $500 A/B/C 40/40/20 must beat BENCH_AB_R2 stress in both windows by max(0.50pp, 10% of absolute benchmark return) without worse ES95 and within the frozen DD limits.
disclosure: Retrospective research only. A development pass can only unlock held-out replay; it cannot approve live trading.
